infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Disaster Sentinel uses your location to deliver real-time life-saving hazard alerts and safe zone evacuation routing.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Continuous background location is required to alert you when entering flood, landslide, or cyclone impact hazard zones.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Disaster Sentinel requires camera access to allow emergency incident reporting and damage severity analysis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Microphone access is required for hands-free voice AI emergency guidance.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow Disaster Sentinel to monitor regional hazard perimeters in real time.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Disaster Sentinel to photograph disaster sites for damage classification.
